paragraphs: Begin by mixing compound and filling each joint. Apply tape to prevent cracks, then build and smooth the surface in layers, inspecting uneven areas under raking light. Sand, remove dust, and hand the surface to the next trade. On old walls, repair the substrate before filling cracks to prevent renewed cracking or powdering.
